scientific_integrity: The theorem separates comultiplication-compatible self-distributive products from the stronger multiplicative-counit condition and does not claim an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-dimensional étale counital coalgebra forms are classified; non-étale forms are outside scope.
The table enumeration is finite corroboration; characteristic independence rests on separable Galois descent.
Older characteristic-two literature under different terminology could contain an equivalent finite-field classification.
title: Eighteen étale two-dimensional self-distributive coalgebra products over every finite field
